items.label: Noir
items.text: Noir: shadows, moral ambiguity, loaded double-meaning dialogue.

items.label: Comedy of errors
items.text: Comedy of errors: miscommunication, bad timing, snowballing consequences.

items.label: Thriller
items.text: Thriller: urgency, immediate stakes, incomplete information, shrinking time.

items.label: Slice of life
items.text: Slice of life: small moments carry weight, comfort in routine, beauty of the mundane.

items.label: Horror
items.text: Horror: wrongness at the edges, something off, unease from ordinary details.

items.label: Romance
items.text: Romance: tension in proximity, unspoken want, gestures over words, timing matters.

items.label: Heist
items.text: Heist: planning, contingencies, moving parts, closing windows.

items.label: Tragedy
items.text: Tragedy: inevitability, costly choices, dramatic irony the reader feels but characters do not.

items.label: Satire
items.text: Satire: absurdity played straight, institutions exposed through their own logic.

items.label: Western
items.text: Western: standoffs, earned respect, clashing moral codes, landscape as character.

items.label: Mystery
items.text: Mystery: clues surface naturally, something does not add up, curiosity pulls forward.

items.label: Political drama
items.text: Political drama: competing agendas, alliances of convenience, calculated speech, trust as currency.

items.label: Survival
items.text: Survival: limited resources, hostile environment, triage decisions.

items.label: Coming of age
items.text: Coming of age: first confrontation, tested identity, cracking certainty.

items.label: Farce
items.text: Farce: escalating absurdity, stubborn dignity while everything collapses.

items.label: Gothic
items.text: Gothic: decay, obsession, rotting beauty, the past refusing burial, choking atmosphere.

items.label: Domestic drama
items.text: Domestic drama: family tension, weaponized history, love and resentment coexisting.

items.label: Picaresque
items.text: Picaresque: cunning over virtue, transactional encounters, charm as survival.

items.label: Courtroom drama
items.text: Courtroom drama: accusation, defense, evidence, judgment; the verdict matters.

items.label: Magical realism
items.text: Magical realism: one impossible thing in an ordinary world, treated as normal.

items.label: Body horror
items.text: Body horror: the physical self becomes alien or wrong; visceral, specific discomfort.

items.label: Espionage
items.text: Espionage: layered deception, double meanings, tested loyalties, need-to-know truth.

items.label: Buddy comedy
items.text: Buddy comedy: mismatched friction becoming fondness, banter carrying the scene.

items.label: War story
items.text: War story: exhaustion, camaraderie under pressure, gallows humor, gap between orders and reality.

items.label: Folklore
items.text: Folklore: archetypes in modern behavior, repeating patterns, old stories with new faces.

items.label: Workplace drama
items.text: Workplace drama: hierarchy, office politics, competence vs. connections, petty power with real stakes.

items.label: Road story
items.text: Road story: movement as point, landscape shifts mood, brief strangers leave marks.

items.label: Psychological thriller
items.text: Psychological thriller: paranoia, unreliable perception, questioned or manipulated reality.

items.label: Slapstick
items.text: Slapstick: physical comedy, momentum, hostile universe played for laughs.

items.label: Melodrama
items.text: Melodrama: emotions at maximum, every revelation lands like a bomb, unironic sincerity.

items.label: Existential
items.text: Existential: confronting meaninglessness, small choices enormous against vast indifference.

items.label: Revenge
items.text: Revenge: someone is owed; the debt shapes every interaction, patience weaponized, satisfaction never clean.

items.label: Epistolary
items.text: Epistolary: filtered through letters, messages, notes, calls, or records rather than direct action.

items.label: Dark comedy
items.text: Dark comedy: terrible things happen and they are funny; humor and horror coexist without defusing each other.

items.label: Fairy tale
items.text: Fairy tale: clear moral stakes, character tests, poetic reward-and-punishment logic.

items.label: Cyberpunk
items.text: Cyberpunk: intimate invasive technology, corporate weather, mutable identity, style as resistance.

items.label: Wuxia
items.text: Wuxia: honor, martial discipline, skill hierarchy, loyalty tested by principle, combat as philosophy.

items.label: Cosmic horror
items.text: Cosmic horror: vast incomprehensible something brushes the scene; human concerns feel small; knowledge is dangerous.

items.label: Found family
items.text: Found family: strangers becoming essential, chosen loyalty, vulnerability as the price of belonging.

items.label: Bottle episode
items.text: Bottle episode: one location, no escape; proximity forces confrontation distance would have prevented.

items.label: Comedy
items.text: Comedy: Office of Structural Absurdity. Knows exactly when to drop the punchline. And when to hold it.

items.label: Drama
items.text: Drama: Directorate of Excavated Truth. Cracks people open. Finds what they buried and puts it on the table.

items.label: Fantasy
items.text: Fantasy: Institute for Structural Wonder. Builds worlds that feel lived-in. Magic has weight, cost, and texture.

items.label: Sci-Fi
items.text: Sci-Fi: Cold Wonder Observatory. Systems that hum. Follows what the tech does to the people.

items.label: Action
items.text: Action: Spatial Violence Task Force. You know where every fist lands and why it hurts.

items.label: Supernatural
items.text: Supernatural: Office of Residual Presence. The door wasn't there yesterday. Doesn't explain. Moves on.

items.label: Surreal/Absurdist
items.text: Surreal/Absurdist: Institute for Threshold Architecture. The rules changed. Nobody sent a memo.

items.label: Martial Epic
items.text: Martial Epic: Order of the Falling Blossom. One strike, ten years of training. The tea gets cold while they talk.

items.label: Superhero
items.text: Superhero: Bureau of Inherited Burden. The powers are the easy part. The person underneath is the problem.

items.label: Adventure
items.text: Adventure: Unmapped Territory Directorate. Wet boots, wrong turns, and the map was outdated three towns ago.
